title: 합쳐진 말: 손+목=손목
objective: By the end, you can split ten common compound words (손목, 눈물, 김밥, 꽃집, 밤낮 and more) into their two parts, guess their meaning from those parts, and use them in short everyday sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday Korean words made by joining two short words, such as 손 + 목 = 손목, and use them in short sentences.

task.title: Build and use compound words
task.line: Join the parts, choose the right word, or answer with one compound word from the list.

words.exampleMeaning: My wrist hurts because I used the computer for a long time.
I fell on the stairs and hurt my ankle.
I cried (tears came) after watching that movie.
The children are making a snowman in the yard.

words.meaning: gimbap, rice rolled in seaweed (김 seaweed + 밥 rice)
words.example: 소풍 갈 때 김밥을 싸 가요.
words.exampleMeaning: We pack gimbap when we go on a picnic.
It was my mom's birthday, so I bought flowers at the flower shop.

words.example: 회사 앞 빵집은 아침 일찍 문을 열어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The bakery in front of my office opens early in the morning.
It's raining, so wear a raincoat when you go.

words.meaning: day and night, all the time (밤 night + 낮 day)
words.exampleMeaning: I studied day and night because of the exam.

words.meaning: front and back (앞 front + 뒤 back)
words.exampleMeaning: Be sure to check both sides of the test paper.

exercises: Write the word made from the two parts: ① 손 + 목 ② 꽃 + 집 ③ 밤 + 낮
Choose the right word for each blank (김밥 / 빵집 / 비옷): ① 우산이 없으면 ____을 입으세요. ② 아침에 ____에서 샌드위치를 샀어요. ③ 편의점에서 ____ 한 줄을 사 먹었어요.
In these words, does 눈 mean 'eye' or 'snow'? Answer in English: ① 눈물 ② 눈사람
Which part of the body hurts? Answer with one Korean word: ① 테니스를 치다가 시계를 차는 곳이 아파요. ② 축구를 하다가 발과 다리 사이가 아파요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 아기가 아파서 엄마가 ____으로 아기 옆에 있었어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 이 티셔츠는 ____가 비슷해서 거꾸로 입기 쉬워요.
answers: ① 손목 ② 꽃집 ③ 밤낮
① 비옷 ② 빵집 ③ 김밥
